title: Counting instances per class
description:
Write `template <typename T> class Counted`, a CRTP mixin that keeps track of how many objects of the inheriting class are alive.

- Constructors (default, copy and move) add one; the destructor subtracts one.
- `static int alive()` returns the count.
- Because `Counted<Enemy>` and `Counted<Bullet>` are **different classes**, each gets its own separate counter. That is the whole trick.
- Make the constructors and destructor `protected`: a `Counted<T>` should only exist as part of a `T`.
hints: `static inline int s_alive{ 0 };` inside `Counted<T>` exists once per T, so each class gets its own count.
Write the default, copy and move constructors to `++s_alive` and the destructor to `--s_alive`, all under `protected:`.
